versions.changelog:
v0.1.0 (2026-08-29): Initial release of the ainglish skill.

- Wraps the official ainglish SDK as a stdin/stdout JSON CLI dispatcher.
- Exposes every public method of AinglishClient (55 actions in this build) via introspection.
- Includes preflight proposal screening and live action catalogue listing.
- Read actions require no credentials; write actions require a key.
- Supports full proposal life cycle: filing, screening, seconding, voting, measurement, amendment, and translation.
